methodology.environment: Isolated local Miniflare/workerd + SQLite; no staging or production bindings.
methodology.timing: Closed-loop requests per lane; reported latency includes dispatch, test SQL instrumentation and JSON decoding. No external network latency.
methodology.workload: Deterministic round-robin mixed workload. Each lane visits all nine operations. Per-operation throughput is its contribution within the mixed stage, not isolated maximum throughput.
methodology.logging: The local test bridge suppresses production console.log to avoid terminal I/O dominating local timings; production source and deployed logging are unchanged.
methodology.rowsRead: unavailable: local Miniflare does not expose authoritative billed D1 rows_read; no bill or SLA estimate is derived.
methodology.rateLimits: Production HTTP requests use distinct synthetic trusted CF IPs to avoid saturating one-IP policy. The atomic limiter microbenchmark uses the actual helper with a high test-only maximum.
methodology.refresh: Native authorize/consent/PKCE exchange setup; one rotating refresh token per concurrent lane, never shared between lanes.
methodology.seed: One shared local-only Better Auth hash; native migrations, indexes and triggers remain enabled. Bulk seed is performed only with Miniflare closed.
methodology.permissions: The test bridge requires a random run key and exists only under work/scale. It is not built into production.
